name: security-auction-bid-state-review
intent: Auction bid identity, increment rules and close-time commitment
artifacts: Bid acceptance, auction clock/close policy, bidder eligibility and winner/payment transition.
trace: Track server authority over bid value, bidder, auction and finalization, including edited/withdrawn bids and stale close state.
experiment: Use a local auction with synthetic bids and compare a legal bid with one expired or unauthorized transition.
disproof: A leader shown in a client feed is not a committed winner; identify the authoritative auction result.
repair: Enforce eligibility/value/time at acceptance and finalization, preserving legitimate withdrawal and tied-bid policy.
branch_decisions: Use the authoritative clock and close/extension policy, including anti-sniping extensions if present. Feed delivery timing is not bid acceptance timing. Separate an invalid bid accepted into authoritative state from a stale displayed leader or a legitimate tie-break rule.
operational_method: Build the product state table for open, extended, closed, withdrawn and settled states, including tie rules and any escrow/payment prerequisite. Record authoritative bid acceptance time separately from feed delivery. Compare an owned replacement/withdrawal before close with the same forbidden transition after effective close. A late display update or a legitimate anti-sniping extension does not establish acceptance of an invalid bid.
